# E4-AG HELLO-Like No-Sign Result  **Purpose:** Record the result of adding targeted hands-visible HELLO-like no-sign footage to the signing-gate dataset.  **Scope:** Offline dataset expansion and gate retraining/evaluation only. No Android integration, TFLite export, production recognizer replacement, or vocabulary expansion.  **Current status:** COMPLETE / STRUCTURAL PASS / OFFLINE GATE PASS.  **Last updated:** 2026-08-02.  ## Verified Project References  - Capture/review run: `artifacts/recognition_upgrade/e2e_c0/hello_like_p1_capture_01` - Expansion runner: `pipeline/rgb/e4_ag_hello_like_nosign_expansion.py` - Expanded dataset: `artifacts/recognition_upgrade/e4_generalization/e4_ag_hello_like_nosign_expansion_01` - Gate run: `artifacts/recognition_upgrade/e4_generalization/e4_ag_low_motion_gate_01` - Gate check: `artifacts/recognition_upgrade/e4_generalization/e4_ag_low_motion_gate_01/check_report.json`  ## Capture Review Result  The reviewed HELLO-like P1 no-sign capture passed:  - rows: `160` - eligible visible-hand no-sign rows: `116` - no-visible-hand rows: `44` - participants: `P03`, `P04` - devices: `phoneA`, `phoneB` - environment: `indoor` - camera facing: `front`  ## Expanded Dataset  The expanded no-sign tensor passed structural validation:  - base E4-AA no-sign rows: `288` - added HELLO-like P1 rows: `116` - combined rows: `404` - shape: `[404,96,258]` - split counts: train `235`, validation `78`, test `91` - source counts: N0 `180`, P1 `108`, P1_HELLO_LIKE `116` - mean hand-hit rate:   - N0: `0.0277`   - P1: `0.7068`   - P1_HELLO_LIKE: `0.7489`  ## Gate Result  The E4-AC low-motion-aware gate was rerun against the expanded E4-AG no-sign dataset.  Summary:  - mean test accepted precision: `0.9798` - minimum test accepted precision: `0.9739` - mean test positive coverage: `0.9746` - minimum test positive coverage: `0.9661` - max test no-sign false commit rate: `0.0000` - mean/min GOOD recall: `0.9667/0.9667` - mean/min SORRY recall: `0.9667/0.9667`  The structural check passed with `--require-metrics`.  ## Interpretation  This is the first real no-sign gate result that clearly passes the offline safety floor while preserving low-motion `SORRY`.  The key improvement came from targeted data, not from generic threshold tuning:  - E4-AF showed policy-only thresholding could not remove HELLO false commits without damaging HELLO recall. - E4-AG added HELLO-like hands-visible no-sign rows. - The retrained gate reduced held-out no-sign false commits to `0.0000` while preserving positive coverage.  ## Decision  E4-AG passes the offline signing/no-sign safety-floor gate for the current 5-class routed system.  This does not authorize Android integration or TFLite export yet. It does authorize moving to E5-A large dual-source candidate screening as the next vocabulary-scale step.  ## Remaining Limits  - This is still an offline isolated-window experiment. - The HELLO-like expansion has only two new participants and indoor/front-camera footage. - Android streaming behavior and temporal stability remain untested. - The current gate was trained/evaluated around a small routed vocabulary: `GOOD`, `HELLO`, `HAVE`, `KNOW`, `SORRY`, and `NO_SIGN`.  ## Next Required Action  Prepare E5-A large dual-source candidate screening across:  - `F:\ASL DATASET\ASL CITIZEN` - `F:\ASL DATASET\local`  Use existing features first and rank candidate signs into Tier A/B/C/D before any large training or Android work.

Test summary across seeds:  - mean accepted precision: `0.7844` - minimum accepted precision: `0.7687` - mean positive coverage: `0.9746` - minimum positive coverage: `0.9661` - maximum real no-sign false-commit rate: `0.9688` - mean/min `SORRY` recall: `0.9667` - mean/min `GOOD` recall: `0.9667` - gate result: failed.  False commits by no-sign source:  - Seed `101`: N0 `13/16`, P1 `15/16` - Seed `202`: N0 `16/16`, P1 `15/16` - Seed `303`: N0 `14/16`, P1 `13/16`  Main false labels:  - N0 often committed as `SORRY`. - P1 often committed as `GOOD`, `HELLO`, or `KNOW`.  ## Interpretation  E4-X's zero-landmark no-sign pass was not sufficient. Real no-sign footage still produces pose landmarks and sometimes partial hand landmarks. However, the binary temporal gate over-rejected low-motion real signs, especially `SORRY`. This makes it unsafe for silent translation because it would miss real signs even while avoiding no-sign hallucinations.  ## Decision  No Android export, no production integration, no vocabulary expansion. The next step is to test a conservative or uncertainty-aware gate policy that explicitly protects low-motion signs before concluding a new gate architecture or more training data is required.
